profile.headline: Software Engineer at ProPartners | Mizzou Alumni
profile.summary:
Everything really clicked for me when I started my educational journey at the University of Missouri. Here, I pursued my passion for technology design, business and problem-solving, and earned my Bachelor's degree in Information Technology in Spring 2025.

Currently, I’m part of ProPartners, where I serve as our Software Engineer. In this role, I started out assisting veterinary practices across the country in achieving their business goals by delivering accurate and driven financial insights. Over time, my role has expanded to include new responsibilities including website design, API integration, workflow automation, accounting and consultancy tool design, internal and external dashboard architecture, and so much more.

Looking ahead, I aim to further my career in data analysis, accounting and cybersecurity, and combine my love for numbers and technology to create innovative solutions for businesses and individuals.

Outside of my professional career, I enjoy music, cars, and sports, and I’m fortunate to have the unwavering support of two wonderful parents and a little sister!
